brief: 5 ways to kill self-doubt before it kills you.

slots.title: SELF-DOUBT IS A LIAR. SILENCE IT NOW
NAME THE INNER CRITIC
slots.body: Self-doubt thrives in anonymity. Give your negative voice a ridiculous name and watch its power dissolve into comedy.

slots.title: ACT BEFORE YOU FEEL READY
slots.body: Confidence follows action, not the other way around. Take one small step today and let momentum build your courage.

slots.title: TRACK PROOF OF WINS
slots.body: Your brain forgets success to focus on fear. Keep a running list of past victories to silence the noise.

slots.title: LIMIT COMPARISON TRAPS
slots.body: Scrolling highlight reels feeds insecurity. Unfollow accounts that trigger doubt and reclaim your own definition of progress.

slots.title: TALK BACK TO FEAR
slots.body: Challenge every doubtful thought with evidence. Speaking your counter-argument aloud disrupts the loop and rewires your mindset fast.

slots.title: EMBRACE DISCOMFORT DAILY
slots.body: Growth lives outside your comfort zone. Do one thing that scares you every day and watch doubt starve.

slots.headline: DOUBT IS A LIAR
slots.body: Pick one tactic and use it today. Your future self is waiting.
